doc.para: Identifier
This class comprises strings or codes assigned to instances of E1 CRM Entity in order to identify them uniquely and permanently within the context of one or more organisations.
has symbolic content
This property associates an instance of E90 Symbolic Object with a complete, identifying representation of its content in the form of a string of text.
has type
This property allows sub typing of CRM entities - Loss of the documenting character of the respective description.
has note
This property is a container for all informal descriptions about an object that have not been expressed in terms of CRM constructs.

Agent
A Person, or Group, or an entity created by a Person or Group (Mechanism), or a Position, that acts in the world.

Place
This class comprises portions of space of fixed shape that are continuous and have a direct connection to the Earth.

Event
This class comprises identifiable changes in states or conditions of persistent items.
Beginning of Existence
This class comprises events that result in the existence of an instance of E77 Persistent Item.
Production
This class comprises activities that result in the creation of material or immaterial items.
Creation
This class comprises actions intentionally carried out by a human or group that result in the creation of a new immaterial or material item.
Birth
This class comprises events that result in the birth of an instance of E21 Person.
End of Existence
This class comprises events that result in the final destruction of an instance of E77 Persistent Item.
Destruction
This class comprises intentional destructions of instances of E18 Physical Thing.
Death
This class comprises events that result in the end of life of an instance of E21 Person.
Activity
This class comprises actions intentionally carried out by a human or group that result in changes of state in the cultural, social or physical systems documented.
Acquisition
This class comprises transfers of legal ownership from one or more instances of E39 Actor to another.
Transfer of Custody
This class comprises transfers of physical custody of an object from one or more instances of E39 Actor to another.
Attribute Assignment
This class comprises the actions of assigning a value or quality to an instance of E1 CRM Entity.
Type Assignment
This class comprises activities formally assigning an instance of E55 Type to an instance of E1 CRM Entity.
Concept Scheme
A SKOS concept scheme can be viewed as an aggregation of one or more SKOS concepts.
Concept

This class comprises non-material products of our minds and other human produced data that have become objects of a discourse about their identity, circumstances of creation, or historical implication.
Human Made Object

This class comprises all persistent physical objects of any size that are purposely created by human activity and have physical boundaries that separate them completely in an objective way from other objects.
